cardOverview.overviewText: A lifestyle card tailored for millennials, providing accelerated cashback on online shopping, travel, and dining, with milestone rewards and lifestyle benefits.

benefitRows.name: Swiggy
benefitRows.offer: Upto 20% discount on partnered restaurant at Swiggy dineout.
benefitRows.howToAvail: To avail this benefit, log in to the Swiggy or Dineout app or website using your registered account. Browse the available dining and order-in offers, select your favorite meals or restaurants, and apply the benefit at checkout to enjoy up to 20% savings at 20,000+ partner restaurants. Complete the payment using your HDFC Millennia credit card to unlock the offer.
